about.title: Pacific Grove Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Pacific Grove is a small town, just over fifteen thousand people at the tip of the Monterey Peninsula, and a death here is felt by neighbors, not only by family. Losses that lead to a wrongful death claim in Monterey County rarely share one cause. Some follow a collision on Forest Avenue or Lighthouse Avenue; others trace back to a fall at a rental property, a medical error, or a product that failed. In 2025, public records show 34 injury collisions and 38 people hurt on Pacific Grove streets, with no traffic fatalities recorded that year. That is a reason for quiet relief, not a reason to assume it cannot happen. When it does, California law gives a spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a civil claim, entirely separate from anything a prosecutor decides. LawProactive is not a law firm. We listen, then introduce you to an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases on contingency, and the introduction itself costs you nothing.

whyChoose.title: Why Pacific Grove Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: We help sort out who has standing
items.desc: California limits who may file: a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is real, and sometimes shorter
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but when a city, county, or state agency is involved, the window to give notice is considerably shorter. Early contact protects your options.

items.title: Every category of loss gets counted
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance are all recoverable. The attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Pacific Grove recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death cases are rare here?
items.answer: Fatal crashes are only one path to a wrongful death claim. Deaths from medical mistakes, falls, care-facility neglect, or defective products happen in towns of every size, including quiet ones like Pacific Grove. The local crash count is a neutral public record, not a measure of whether your family's loss is worth pursuing.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as the criminal case against the person responsible?
items.answer: No. A criminal case is brought by the Monterey County District Attorney and focuses on punishment. A wrongful death claim is a civil action your family brings to recover losses, and it can move forward whether or not criminal charges are filed or result in a conviction.

items.question: What if the death involved a road or vehicle maintained by the City of Pacific Grove or Monterey County?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity follow a different, much shorter timeline than the standard two years, and a formal notice usually has to be filed first. Missing that step can end a claim before it starts. This is one of the reasons we encourage families to connect with an attorney soon after a loss, even while they are still grieving.
